Commentary.Commentary: Two matches done and dusted and what this series is telling us that it is a deathbed for the bowlers. How will the third ODI turn out to be? It is a dead rubber but India will aim for a whitewash while England will play for pride. Both teams will have one eye on the Champions Trophy preparations which is later this year. The final ODI is in Kolkata, so run-scoring may not be that easy. Join us on Sunday, 22nd January, 2017 at 1330 IST (0800 GMT). Until then, Adios! Take Care!

YUVRAJ SINGH has been named the Man Of The Match for his 127-ball 150. He admits that the domestic season really helped him, not only for his form but also his fitness. Smiles shyly on being asked about marriage bringing him luck, but credits his mother and sage too. On his stand with Dhoni, he says that the pair knows each other and played according to the situation. Adds that they were not looking for a big score and only looked to concentrate on getting a partnership. Further says after 40 overs, with wickets in hand, even 350 was gettable. Rates this innings as his best ever in ODIs. Says that he wanted to prove a point to myself than anyone else. Credits his diet regime for his fitness levels.

Victorious Indian captain VIRAT KOHLI says that he was wondering where India would have ended up had the team got off to a good start. Praises both the stalwarts, Dhoni and Yuvraj and stresses that this was why Yuvraj was brought back into the side. Says that 340 was par but chaseable, because of the way England go hard at the ball. Adds that 380 was out of reach. Praises his bowlers for bowling really well in spite of the dew. Feels that the next game will be the key for the Indian top order to express itself. Is happy about the batting order's depth and just needs a bit of working over. Praises his spinners for doing well, especially for picking up wickets in the middle overs and pulling things back. Adds that India have played only to 75 percent of its potential and Kolkata might be the place to give its 100 percent.

England skipper, EOIN MORGAN says that his team was not at its best again, with either bat or ball. Admits that India outplayed them on similar conditions to the other night. Agrees that the bowling failed today and they came up against Dhoni and Yuvraj on a rampage. Says that they tried hard to break the partnership but could not do so. On the run chase, he is proud of the fight shown by his side but feels that they lacked the skill. Thanks the fans for supporting both teams.

Not a series for bowlers. Around 700 runs were scored the other night and tonight, 747 have been scored. The spinners did the trick for India, with Ashwin and Jadeja going for just 110 in 20 overs combined, picking up 4 wickets. Bhuvneshwar Kumar was excellent at the death, stifling the batsmen.
India were a bit worried during the 40-over mark but Moeen Ali's wicket opened the floodgates. In the end, it was too much left for Morgan to do and he fell after scoring a magnificent 102.

England did not get off to the best of starts, losing Alex Hales early. But then, Roy and Root fought hard with a century stand. India then bounced back with three wickets in 32 balls and the tourists seemed to be getting rolled over. But Moeen Ali and skipper Morgan then revived their team with a quickfire stand of 93 from just 73 balls.

Another excellent contest. The result was not too much in doubt after India made 381 but Eoin Morgan took the game close, giving the hosts some doubts. Eventually, it turned out to be 20 runs too many for the visiting side.

Short and wide outside off, cut straight to point where Ravindra Jadeja fumbles and the batsmen take a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
On middle and leg, clipped towards square leg.
FOUR! That is a terrific shot. Fractionally short in length outside off, Root bends a touch and slashes this between point and backward point for a boundary!
Landed outside off, Root looks to slash but misses.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Outside off, Root plays inside the line and is beaten.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Outside off, Roy looks to tap it towards third man but gets a bottom edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards point and the batsmen take a single.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Almost an action replay of the second ball of the over. A length ball again, Roy steers it behind point for a boundary!
Outside off, dabbed straight to short third man.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Fine shot. On a length outside off, Root stays back and punches it behind point for a boundary!
Goes back in his crease and defends.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Stays back and defends this watchfully.
Outside off, punched off the back foot to mid off.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Outside off, Roy looks to defend but the ball takes the bottom edge and almost goes back onto his stumps. Hits his pads and deflects towards the slips.

FOUR! What a way to get off the mark! On a length outside off, Root punches this behind point. The call is "WAIT!" but the timing is so sweet that it beats the dive from backward point. Races to the fence.
JOE ROOT walks in at number 3, replacing Hales.

OUT! Caught behind! One down, 9 to go. On a good length outside off, Hales looks to push it away but ends up chasing the ball and nicks it behind to Dhoni. Simple catch and India have an early breakthrough.
Down the leg side, clipped away for a single.
Full and outside off, JR feels for the ball and gets beaten.
FOUR! Streaky! On a good length outside off, Roy looks to punch it through the off side but gets a thick inside edge which goes past the stumps to the fine leg fence!

LBW appeal, turned down. Bumrah wants a review but Dhoni says that it is sliding down the leg side. A full toss on middle and leg, Jason misses his flick again and the ball goes off his pads through square leg. A leg bye taken.
WIDE. Full and down the leg side, Roy misses his flick.
FOUR! CRISP! Half volley outside off, Hales leans and drives it wide of mid off for a boundary!

Full and wide outside off, Alex pushes at it and gets another outside edge. This goes wide of Shikhar Dhawan at first slip and races to the third man fence but Jasprit Bumrah covers good ground to his left and stops it with a dive. The batsmen take a couple.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
FOUR! Third man is up and Bhuvi bowls this wide outside off. Hales reaches out and slices it over short third man and gets a boundary.
Full and outside off, Roy pushes this through the covers and sets off for the single. Kohli swoops on to the ball, picks up and throws in one motion but misses the stumps at the bowler's end.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Comes back in a long way from outside off, AH looks to defend but is beaten again.
Full and outside off, driven straight back to the bowler.
FOUR LEG BYES! Harsh on the bowling side. Bumrah almost bowls a yorker, but outside leg, Alex stumbles but the ball goes off his pads to the fine leg fence!
FREE HIT coming up!
NO BALL! That is a jaffa but Bumrah oversteps. He bowls a length ball outside off, gets it to move back in and almost cuts Hales into two.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! CLASSY! Full and wide outside off, Hales eases it through cover-point and gets a boundary!
It will be JASPRIT BUMRAH to bowl with the other new ball.
Full and outside off, JR looks to flick but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. A MAIDEN TO START!
Full and around off, Jason is squared up a touch and defends awkwardly.
Landed outside off, not played at.
Short and outside off, Roy looks to cut but gets a bottom edge towards point.
One more leave outside off. That ball came in a long way.
A length ball outside off, left alone.
The players are back out in the middle. Can England put up a fight? It will be BHUVNESHWAR KUMAR to start off proceedings to Jason Roy. Alex Hales is his partner. Here we go...
